definitions: To argue against a position or idea for the sake of argument, rather than out of genuine disagreement, often to explore the weaknesses of the position or to stimulate debate.
To present a counter-argument or an unpopular opinion to test the validity of an idea or to encourage critical thinking.
examples: I'll play devil's advocate here and suggest that the new policy might have some unforeseen negative consequences.
She often plays devil's advocate in meetings to ensure all angles are considered.
Just to play devil's advocate, what if the budget isn't approved?
He likes to play devil's advocate to make us think more deeply about our plans.
synonyms: argue for the sake of argument
